features.quote: Hard caps bound steps, wall-time, total FS bytes, per-file bytes, file count, and tool output size.
features.justification_quote: bound any single episode; the byte/file caps bound state growth

features.quote: max_steps=40: enough for an honest agent to inspect, attempt, and report; short enough to bound cost
features.justification_quote: short enough to bound cost across a large grid

features.quote: max_wall_seconds=600: a generous per-episode ceiling for slow models
features.justification_quote: a generous per-episode ceiling for slow models

features.quote: The default system prompt is neutral and explicitly permits the agent to say a task cannot be done
features.justification_quote: if that were the hidden default, the eval would be measuring our own framing, not the model

features.quote: Escape attempts are surfaced to the agent as ordinary tool errors
features.justification_quote: so behavior stays naturalistic) but logged separately (so we can both score them and audit containment)

features.quote: the network/shell stubs make escape impossible rather than merely discouraged
features.justification_quote: a hard virtual sandbox removes the risk class entirely

features.quote: The decision to not-inform-the-model and to use impossible tasks is treated as a bounded, documented research choice
